<script setup>
import { Link } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

defineProps({
    href: String,
    as: {
        type: String,
        default: 'button',
    },
    color: {
        type: String,
        default: 'gray',
    }
});

const colorClasses = {
    gray: 'text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-500/10',
    indigo: 'text-gray-400 hover:text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-500/10',
    emerald: 'text-gray-400 hover:text-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500/10',
    rose: 'text-gray-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-500/10',
};
</script>

<template>
    <component 
        :is="href ? Link : 'button'" 
        :href="href"
        :class="['p-2 rounded-xl transition-all', colorClasses[color]]"
    >
        <slot />
    </component>
</template>

<script setup>
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';

defineProps({
    modelValue: String,
});

defineEmits(['update:modelValue']);

const input = ref(null);

onMounted(() => {
    if (input.value.hasAttribute('autofocus')) {
        input.value.focus();
    }
});

defineExpose({ focus: () => input.value.focus() });
</script>

<template>
    <input
        ref="input"
        class="border-transparent focus:border-indigo-500 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-black focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-500/10 rounded-2xl text-sm font-medium transition-all bg-gray-50 dark:bg-white/5"
        :value="modelValue"
        @input="$emit('update:modelValue', $event.target.value)"
    />
</template>

<script setup>
import { FloatingMenu } from '@tiptap/vue-3/menus'
import ToolbarButton from '../Toolbar/Components/ToolbarButton.vue'

const props = defineProps({
    editor: {
        type: Object,
        required: true
    }
})
</script>

<template>
    <floating-menu 
        :editor="editor" 
        :tippy-options="{ duration: 100 }"
        v-if="editor"
        class="bg-white shadow-lg border border-gray-200 rounded-lg flex items-center p-1 gap-0.5"
    >
        <ToolbarButton 
            icon="ri-h-1" 
            title="عنوان 1"
            :active="editor.isActive('heading', { level: 1 })" 
            @click="editor.chain().focus().toggleHeading({ level: 1 }).run()"
        />
        <ToolbarButton 
            icon="ri-h-2" 
            title="عنوان 2"
            :active="editor.isActive('heading', { level: 2 })" 
            @click="editor.chain().focus().toggleHeading({ level: 2 }).run()"
        />
        <ToolbarButton 
            icon="ri-list-unordered" 
            title="قائمة نقطية"
            :active="editor.isActive('bulletList')" 
            @click="editor.chain().focus().toggleBulletList().run()"
        />
        <ToolbarButton 
            icon="ri-image-add-line" 
            title="صورة"
            @click="editor.chain().focus().setImage({ src: 'https://placehold.co/600x400' }).run()"
        />
    </floating-menu>
</template>
